problem: Regular attendance is defined as missing less than 10% of school days (or fewer than 2 absences per month), regardless of the reason. According to Washington state's Office of Superintendent of Public Instruction's report card data, which elementary schools in District 7 of Seattle Public Schools had less than 70% of students with regular attendance in the 2021-22 school year? Do not include K-8 schools.
answer: Dunlap Elementary School, Emerson Elementary School, Graham Hill Elementary School, Martin Luther King Jr. Elementary School, Wing Luke Elementary School, Rainier View Elementary School
